 Where the National Capital Region
 workforce begins
 Genesys Works is dedicated to empowering youth through professional development and work experience. Our mission is to provide young professionals with the skills and opportunities they need to succeed in the workforce.

 become a partner 
 Our MOdel
 Skills Training 
 Students start their journey by completing eight weeks of rigorous business techonology training, gaining essential skills in the areas of information technology, business operations and professional development. 
 Meaningful Internships 
 Once students successfully complete their skills training course, they are matched to a paid, year-long internship at a partner company site.  
 College and Career Coaching 
 While students are working at their internship, they are also receiving more than sixty hours of guidance, counseling, and planning relative to their future career path.  
 Alumni Support 
 After you graduate from high school and finish your internship, Genesys Works continues to support you through our Alumni Program. Our team helps you navigate post-secondary education and any challenges, ensuring you succeed in your education and career.
